title: END RUN from the demo pause menu halves the score like a death
why: His Q60 (2026-10-18): ending early halves the score, the same as dying. In the demo a death or the burn already counted half, but END RUN from the pause menu paid in full, so a guest could keep a high score by ending the run instead of dying. END RUN now halves both scores (one player and two), player 2 halves its own figures from the same run end word without the failure music, and the RUN OVER card says ended early -50%. An idle out is left alone for now (question 78) and an extraction still doubles.
now: End run from the demo pause menu now counts half the score, on the RUN OVER card (both players) and the board, the same as dying.
